baseline: locked simplified v1, two rounds, four references, PCA; official sample indices, labels opened after sealing
panels: Preserve all 501 previously sealed direction rows. In ordinary Validation take up to 48 previously unused physical clouds per platform in recording round-robin order, then up to 48 more with explicit left/right ... of in the caption, independently of labels. Hash order. No repeated physical cloud across these new batches or older batches. All fallbacks included.
intervention: Largest overlap-smoothed native D reference mass with at least four visible returns, then highest remaining such mass allowing a disjoint congruent axis-aligned exchange cell. All returns in both cells exchange centers without rotation. The two new cells must be disjoint. F and N preserve all words except the designated reference noun span. A four-way contrast uses identical sampled indices, and the original camera projects each new physical realization.
assignment: Evaluate normalized overlap density at the original physical subject anchors for each scene-caption condition. The probability gamma that the original scene supports the full name is sigmoid of the crossed difference in log density. h is the original order likelihood divided by its sum across both scenes for the same moved landmark. The agreement factor is 1+(2 gamma-1)(2 h-1). Missing evidence and subjects touching either cell give factor 1. Use reference masses fixed by D and marginalize. Main identity prediction uses all A256. Also preserve the v1 prior on its original four slots.
geometry: For the fixed raw main winner, local weights are the four matched view masses times physical affinity to the anchor. Moved-region boxes from the edited scene are excluded. Main version transports the selected role factor from A256 via physical affinity. Along the original long horizontal axis maximize weighted coverage by the open intervals on which box IoU exceeds 0.50. Retain raw center on a maximal plateau containing zero; otherwise nearest maximal interval midpoint. Fixed yaw, height and sizes. Compare unconditioned intervals and tensor mean on identical views, raw winner and axis.
readout: Report all directions, paired rescues/harms, macro Acc@25 and Acc@50, mIoU; natural dual identity where independently adjudicated (separate from proxy), original and expanded-pool oracle crossings on the same correctly identified raw subject, recording-cluster uncertainty. Different neutral reference wording does not imply a known counterfactual target.
decision: Advance only on actual transferable identity correction beyond same-information control and useful new geometry on correct instances beyond raw and unconditioned geometry. Compare independent physical frame clusters. No target, source or architecture tuning. Do not use FINAL.
